summary: Compare publication and reconcile launch changes against the running incarnation's start evidence.

replay.detail: Adds rebuildable local publication evidence. Existing stores bootstrap retained runtime observations and start-success evidence after API bind in durable, bounded writer pages. Explicit full replay resets this evidence to an incomplete bootstrap; no claim rewrite or derived-table version change.

schema.detail: Adds five local derived tables and lookup indexes over those small tables, plus exact source-delta triggers. A local launch-source generation invalidates cached evidence on repair, trim and replay; one constant-size commit-observer read publishes that invalidation. No new index scans the claims or local_observations table at open. Numeric schema version and replicated claim bodies are unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and replicated digests are unchanged. Publication fact tables, pending deltas and bootstrap progress are explicitly local derived state in the canonical audit and never participate in shared digests.

compatibility.detail: Publication preview and reconcile share a judgment against the checked origin and running incarnation, including declaration drift and distinct Unknown evidence. Incomplete bootstrap is fail-closed for the internal writer guard, with publication-evidence-incomplete visible in doctor. Default adopted runtimes continue running when launch evidence is missing. No public CLI option is added in this slice; mixed-build fleets have not been exercised.

downtime.detail: Source-table index builds were rejected after an estimated 71.26 seconds on the frozen production-size census. Empty derived-schema setup measured 0.43–0.57 seconds in native WAL/FULL scratch probes; bootstrap measured 22.70 seconds over matching rows and 41.58 seconds for the two indexed shared kinds read from the immutable census. Bootstrap runs after both APIs bind in durable bounded pages. Component writer loans can exceed the between-row processing budget (maximum 1.05 seconds in the matching fixture). Whole deployed restart-to-health is not yet measured; operations will record it on the first authorized deploy. No deliberate seat interruption is added.

manual.detail: No manual migration is required; the daemon advances bootstrap from its durable cursor. A corrupt historical source stops bootstrap with a doctor warning; repair the source and restart the daemon to resume.

recovery.detail: Earlier binaries ignore the additive local tables and retain their existing comparison. Persisted source triggers capture writes from earlier binaries; a later reopen drains exact pending deltas before evidence is treated as complete. Full replay rebuilds the local evidence asynchronously from retained claims; checkpoint-trimmed launch bodies remain Unknown.
